description: Acceptance criteria for the checkout recovery trial. Frozen and written to sloproof-contracts BEFORE any routing change. Never edited mid-run; a change mid-run invalidates the trial.
limits: Demo acceptance rules, not a statistical guarantee of future production reliability.
Success and latency only. The four-query contract in the architecture PDF (synthetics, OOM, dependency error rates) is not implemented in this scope.
Trial success at 10% is not evidence that v1 sustains 100% of traffic; post-promotion windows are measured separately against the same absolute criteria.
